description: The figure is a pie chart intended to represent four labeled categories related to an “Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge” reasoning benchmark, shown as a circular chart divided into 4 slices of roughly equal size (each approximately one quarter of the circle). The slices are labeled “Complexity” (yellow/gold), “Instance” (light blue), “Coverage” (light green), and “Scalable Oversight” (red), with each label placed inside its corresponding segment along with small icon graphics. The slices are separated by thick white borders, and there are no numeric percentage labels shown inside the segments. No separate legend is present; instead, the labels are embedded directly in the slices. There is no clear exploded/offset emphasis of any single slice, and the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicit descending-size order since they are visually similar in area.
